'''Adan Tranik''' was a [[Gender/Legends|male]]<ref name="TOR" /> [[Human/Legends|Human]]<ref name="Human" /> from the [[Planet/Legends|planet]] [[Zakuul]]<ref name="Zakuul" /> who served in the [[Knights of Zakuul]] during the era in which the [[Eternal Empire]] ruled over [[The galaxy/Legends|the galaxy]]. An elite Knight who held the title of [[Paladin]], Tranik wore dark [[Armor/Legends|armor]] and wielded two [[Color/Legends|blue]] [[Lightsaber/Legends|lightsabers]] in battle. He was stationed aboard the [[Alderaan Star Fortress|Star Fortress]] over the [[Planet/Legends|planet]] [[Alderaan/Legends|Alderaan]], and [[Death/Legends|died]]<ref name="TOR" /> around [[3631 BBY]]<ref name="Date" /> when the [[Star Fortress]] was invaded and destroyed.<ref name="TOR" />

==Behind the scenes==
Adan Tranik was added to [[BioWare]]'s [[2011]] [[Star Wars video games|massively multiplayer online roleplaying video game]] ''[[Star Wars: The Old Republic]]'' in [[Star Wars: The Old Republic: Knights of the Fallen Empire|''Knights of the Fallen Empire'']], a [[2015]] Digital Expansion. He is one of four possible Paladins that can spawn during the Alderaan version of the "The Star Fortress" Flashpoint; as the Star Fortress is destroyed with all hands aboard, this article assumes that Tranik died either in battle or when the [[battle station]] exploded.<ref name="TOR" />
